requirements.name: Account access
requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate students and enforce ownership of their records. A privileged operator shall maintain institutional data.
requirements.acceptance: For two student accounts and one operator, valid login succeeds and invalid login fails. Student A cannot read or modify any profile, transcript, plan or checklist owned by B. Only the operator can update institutional sources.

requirements.name: Persistent academic profile
requirements.statement: The system shall store the student's university, programme, intake, confirmed academic record and declared preparation goals.
requirements.acceptance: Save a profile, sign out, restart the application and sign in through another client. All confirmed fields and revision identifiers match. The user can correct them; the system does not infer missing credits or course completion.

requirements.name: Transcript import and confirmation
requirements.statement: The system shall import text-based PDF transcripts into an editable staging view before activating extracted course, credit and grade fields.
requirements.acceptance: Each valid D1 PDF produces editable fields linked to its file. Saving requires explicit confirmation; incomplete required fields remain flagged. Reject corrupt, encrypted, unsupported or over-10-MB files with an actionable message. Image-only PDFs request manual entry; no data are silently activated.

requirements.name: Current assessment entry
requirements.statement: The system shall support manual entry and correction of current scores, maxima, assessment weights and target results.
requirements.acceptance: Create and edit assessment data for the ten real D5 courses. Scores outside the configured range and inconsistent weights are rejected. Unrecorded assessments remain missing, distinct from a recorded zero. A change creates a new revision.

requirements.name: GPA and grade scenarios
requirements.statement: The system shall calculate credit-weighted GPA and compare hypothetical grades using applicable grading and repeat-attempt rules.
requirements.acceptance: All applicable D2 cases match independently calculated results at the declared rounding precision. Display included attempts, credits, formula and rule version. Hypothetical changes never overwrite the confirmed transcript. Missing repeat rules produce an unresolved result rather than an assumed policy. Cumulative-GPA target cases also check required average over remaining credits, maximum attainable GPA and targets above the configured grade maximum.

requirements.name: Required score and feasibility
requirements.statement: The system shall calculate remaining assessment scores needed for a target and identify targets outside the permitted score range.
requirements.acceptance: All D2 required-score cases match reference answers. Request missing weights or scores; return a conditional formula only when labelled. If the required score exceeds its maximum, state that the target is unreachable and show the maximum attainable result.

requirements.name: Applicable academic rules
requirements.statement: The system shall explain scholarship, exam-admission and progression conditions using the applicable recorded policy.
requirements.acceptance: For answerable D4 policy cases, show the relevant conditions and source version. If a policy, intake, date or personal condition is missing or conflicting, identify it and withhold a definitive eligibility conclusion. Label results as guidance under the cited rules.

requirements.name: Evidence based advising
requirements.statement: The system shall answer academic questions using applicable documents and provide identifiable supporting references.
requirements.acceptance: For each answerable D4 question, return the expected substantive answer with a supporting document and page, section or URL. For the five insufficient-evidence cases, state what is unknown or request clarification. Do not substitute another university's rule.

requirements.name: Degree requirement audit
requirements.statement: The system shall compare confirmed completions with the correct curriculum and identify satisfied and outstanding requirements.
requirements.acceptance: D3 audits match reference mandatory courses, elective groups and credit thresholds. Extra credits in one group do not satisfy another without an explicit rule. Failed and in-progress attempts are not treated as completed. Unresolved course mappings remain visible.

requirements.name: Independent plan validation
requirements.statement: The system shall validate a supplied plan against prerequisite logic, course availability, credit limits and programme requirements.
requirements.acceptance: All D3 candidate plans receive the expected valid, invalid or unresolved result. Every known violation identifies the course, term and constraint. AND/OR logic and permitted concurrent study follow the configuration. A changed profile or rule version triggers revalidation.

requirements.name: Constrained plan generation
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a feasible course sequence or report the correct infeasibility or uncertainty status within a stated horizon.
requirements.acceptance: Generated D3 plans pass the independent validator. Show all elapsed terms, including empty terms. Report earliest completion only when optimality is established. A timeout or no plan within a bounded horizon must not imply that graduation is globally impossible.

requirements.name: Saved plan alternatives
requirements.statement: The system shall save, reopen, revise and compare academic plan and grade scenarios.
requirements.acceptance: Save two distinct alternatives and reopen them from all three clients. Each retains its inputs, profile revision and rules. Display differences in GPA or completion term as applicable. Editing one alternative does not change the other or the confirmed record.

requirements.name: Agent tool workflow
requirements.statement: The agent shall use the confirmed profile and invoke academic services to complete multi-step advising requests.
requirements.acceptance: In two scripted workflows, demonstrate profile retrieval plus calculation or audit plus planning. A trace identifies the actual tools, inputs and outputs. Displayed numeric and validity results match tool outputs. Missing inputs trigger clarification, and unavailable tools produce a clear failure.

requirements.name: AITU programme coverage
requirements.statement: The system shall load versioned curricula for all AITU educational programmes in the authoritative programme and cohort inventory.
requirements.acceptance: Reconcile the coverage manifest against the supplied official inventory. Every listed programme and target cohort has a source-backed configuration and passing audit/validation smoke tests. Missing materials remain blocked and prevent a claim of complete coverage. Detailed assessment evaluation covers ten real courses.

requirements.name: Second university adaptation
requirements.statement: The system shall support one documented programme at a second Kazakhstan university through institutional configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Load D6 without rewriting core calculation or validation logic. Four contrasting cases for grading, prerequisites, term availability and credit limits match their reference outcomes. Switching institutions preserves correct data separation and does not apply AITU rules to the second programme.

requirements.name: Source and rule maintenance
requirements.statement: The system shall allow a privileged operator to add, version and retire academic sources and curriculum configurations.
requirements.acceptance: Publish a revised rule and mark its validity period. New checks select the applicable version; existing saved results retain their original references and show that revalidation is needed. Student accounts cannot perform this operation. Real and mock source records have distinct labels.

requirements.name: Masters programme discovery
requirements.statement: The system shall find and organise selected master's programmes using declared field, location and intended-intake criteria.
requirements.acceptance: For D7, return or filter at least five programmes across two universities using official programme URLs. Every entry records institution, programme, intake and retrieval date. Irrelevant entries are excluded. Missing information is explicit and the list is not presented as exhaustive.

requirements.name: Masters requirement matching
requirements.statement: The system shall compare a confirmed profile with the published requirements of a selected master's programme.
requirements.acceptance: D7 cases correctly distinguish met, unmet, conditional and unknown requirements for degree background, grades, language evidence and prerequisites where published. Show the input and source behind each status. Unknown information cannot become a positive eligibility or admission guarantee.

requirements.name: Preparation checklist and funding
requirements.statement: The system shall create a saved preparation checklist covering documents, published deadlines, outstanding requirements and funding opportunities.
requirements.acceptance: For each D7 programme, show the expected documents, dated deadlines with intake and time-zone information when supplied, and published funding conditions. Missing dates or funding remain unknown. Users can mark tasks complete, reopen the checklist and refresh a changed official page.

requirements.name: User data control
requirements.statement: The system shall let students export and request deletion of the academic data retained by this application.
requirements.acceptance: A student can export their confirmed profile and plans in JSON. After confirmed deletion, their profile, transcript files, plans and chats are unavailable through the application. Other students' data remain intact. Backup-retention behaviour and external-provider limits are explained.

requirements.name: Authorised LMS connection
requirements.statement: If authorised API access becomes available, the system may import the student's permitted LMS records through an optional connector.
requirements.acceptance: Before inclusion, record the authorised scopes and test with a permitted account. Imported fields must match the source; revoked access must stop synchronisation. The transcript and manual-entry workflows remain usable without this connector.

requirements.name: Grade prediction experiment
requirements.statement: If a suitable dataset becomes available, the system may provide a separately evaluated prediction of final course performance.
requirements.acceptance: Before inclusion, document data provenance, prediction-time features, a simple baseline, held-out evaluation and limitations. Report the measured comparison. Mark predictions as uncertain and never use them as confirmed grades or proof of academic eligibility.

requirements.name: Numerical correctness
requirements.statement: All academic calculations and score-feasibility checks shall be produced by explicit software services with declared rounding rules.
requirements.acceptance: All 20 D2 fixtures match their independent reference values or expected missing-data outcome. Results agree across web, Android, iOS and exports. Altering explanatory wording must not change the stored tool result.

requirements.name: Access and data protection
requirements.statement: The system shall restrict student data to authorised users and keep secrets outside clients, model prompts and diagnostic logs.
requirements.acceptance: All 12 D8 negative-access cases are denied. Inspect the deployed HTTPS connection, client bundles and logs for keys or credentials. Five malicious instructions embedded in source fixtures must not cause unauthorised tool execution or disclosure. Real records are not routed to an unreviewed provider.

requirements.name: Source support and applicability
requirements.statement: Policy and admissions explanations shall remain traceable to applicable evidence and preserve uncertainty.
requirements.acceptance: In all 20 D4 questions and D7 matching fixtures, each material policy or admissions claim is supported by the cited passage or marked unknown. Links and source locators resolve. A wrong institution, intake or expired rule is a failed case.

requirements.name: Responsiveness and bounded failure
requirements.statement: The interface shall acknowledge work promptly and terminate stalled workflows with a clear recoverable outcome.
requirements.acceptance: For 100 non-model requests under ten concurrent test sessions, p95 response time is at most 2 seconds. Job acknowledgement appears within 2 seconds. Injected stalls end with a visible error by the configured 120-second workflow deadline; no partial plan is labelled valid.

requirements.name: Task usability
requirements.statement: Students should complete representative tasks without moderator assistance and understand the displayed result.
requirements.acceptance: Five students perform four scripted tasks: confirm an import, inspect a GPA scenario, save a valid plan and create a masters checklist. At least 16 of 20 tasks succeed without hints within 5 minutes each. Record errors and misunderstandings, not only satisfaction.

requirements.name: Web and mobile compatibility
requirements.statement: Student workflows shall be available through the website and installable Android and iOS applications sharing one backend.
requirements.acceptance: Record exact browser and OS versions. Run the core account, import, calculation, audit, plan and masters workflows on Chrome, Edge, one Android device/emulator and one iOS device/simulator. Saved records and results agree; no blocking controls or unreadable essential content remain.

requirements.name: Institutional configurability
requirements.statement: University-specific grading, programme and calendar rules shall be isolated from reusable academic-service logic.
requirements.acceptance: The D6 adaptation changes data/configuration and reruns the four contrasting cases successfully. Inspect the change set: no AITU-specific constant has been added to core arithmetic or validator logic. Test that identical course codes at different institutions remain distinct.

requirements.name: Reproducibility and audit trail
requirements.statement: Each calculation, audit, plan and admissions comparison shall identify the inputs and versions needed to review the result.
requirements.acceptance: For one successful and one failed execution of each core service, retain an operation ID, timestamp, profile revision, rule/source versions and outcome. Model-assisted steps record model and tool identifiers. A clean setup from documented commands reproduces all deterministic D2/D3 results.

requirements.name: Budget and provider control
requirements.statement: The application shall enforce configured model-call and spending limits and disclose which provider processes a request.
requirements.acceptance: With a zero paid allowance, no paid request starts. With a small test allowance and capped output, simulated calls that exceed the reserved allowance are blocked. Quota exhaustion produces an actionable error. No retry or fallback silently selects a paid provider or transfers private data.

requirements.name: Transcript extraction quality
requirements.statement: Transcript extraction shall be measured separately from the correctness of student-confirmed records.
requirements.acceptance: On valid D1 files, exact normalised field precision and recall are each at least 95 percent. Compare course identifier, credit and grade triples with manual ground truth; extra and omitted rows count as errors. After review, every activated field matches the confirmed fixture.

requirements.name: Persistence and recovery
requirements.statement: Confirmed records and plan revisions shall survive service restarts and be recoverable from a documented backup.
requirements.acceptance: Restart services after saving the D8 fixture: no committed record is lost. Restore a test backup and compare record counts, revisions and protected file references with that snapshot. Reapply the deletion ledger so a restored backup does not reactivate previously deleted student data.

requirements.name: Russian and English interaction
requirements.statement: The system shall accept core student requests in Russian and English and preserve identifiers and numeric values across languages.
requirements.acceptance: Run the ten Russian and ten English D4 prompts plus paired D2/D3 tool requests. Both languages route to the intended service; explanations follow the requested language, while the same inputs yield identical numeric and validity results. Source titles may retain their original language.

change_note: ACP-1: explicitly include cumulative-GPA target verification in FR05/AT05; acceptance remains NOT_VERIFIED.
